title: Run all
hints: Calling `task()` in a plain loop runs the tasks one after another: three 1s tasks take 3s. Put `go` in front of each call, then make `RunAll` wait.
Declare `var wg sync.WaitGroup`. For each task: `wg.Add(1)` **before** `go`, and `defer wg.Done()` as the first line inside the goroutine. After the loop, `wg.Wait()`.
`for _, task := range tasks { wg.Add(1); go func() { defer wg.Done(); task() }() }`, then `wg.Wait()`. Since Go 1.22 each iteration has its own `task`, so the closure is safe.
